title: Eleventh Decennial Census of the Population of Scotland taken 31st March 1901, with Report
locator: Vol. 1, Table 1_1, civil county totals, both sexes, 1891 and 1901. Numeric facts transcribed from the contemporary reproduction, Table I in Encyclopaedia Britannica, 11th ed., vol. 24. The 1901 Elgin total uses the census figure of 44,800.
rights: Transcribed counts from public-domain reports. No images reproduced.
